intended_use: Create original Taiwan post-close topic options and cited draft scripts for human review.

channel_promise.audience: 白天無法盯盤、收盤後想快速掌握台股的投資人，尤其是海外台人
channel_promise.job_to_be_done: 用輕鬆口吻講清楚今天盤面發生了什麼、誰在買誰在賣，以及明天要核對什麼
required_coverage: 外資、投信、自營商現貨買賣超
融資融券與借券的情緒線索
台指期、基差、未平倉與選擇權風險線索
一至兩個能代表當日矛盾的事件或股票
下一交易日可量測的觀察點

sample_evidence.title: 【🔥記憶體雙雄瘋了！】南亞科天價553後翻黑、華邦電盤中噴4%被關緊閉！台股46K警報響起？
【記憶體雙雄暴沖！】南亞科飆破5字頭、華邦電狠起來連自己都怕？臺股散戶必看！

old_corpus_references.observed_role: 比較題、技術面證據排序、盤後多種敘事變體
old_corpus_references.allowed_use: creator-neutral comparison and evidence-order patterns only

old_corpus_references.observed_role: 由大盤到產業主線，再用多個標的解釋同一條邏輯
事件衝擊、機制拆解、舊數據糾錯、限制條件與個人反思
old_corpus_references.allowed_use: creator-neutral fact-check and limitation pattern only

observed_identity.topic_preference: 用一個盤面矛盾串起兩個主角股票，再回到大盤與次日問題
tone: 可用比喻但不能蓋過事實
observed_identity.title_pattern: 情緒或衝突 + 兩個主角/一個族群 + 盤中轉折或關鍵數字 + 大盤懸念
observed_identity.hook_pattern: 先用一句話說今天最反常或最刺激的地方，再提出這是主線、洗盤還是出貨的核心問題
narrative_order: 一句盤面情緒與核心矛盾
加權指數、成交值與市場廣度
主角一的盤中路徑和可核驗事件
主角二的盤中路徑和差異
三大法人、融資券、期貨選擇權交叉驗證
下一交易日三個可量測檢查點
開放式問題與一般訂閱提醒
observed_identity.pacing: 短句開場，中段用數據和反問交替，結尾降速給條件式判斷
observed_identity.ending_pattern: 不猜單一方向；以如果/否則列出明天驗證點，再問觀眾如何理解今天的盤

repeated_mechanisms: 用一句情緒化但可回到數據核驗的盤面感受開場
先交代加權指數，再指出真正主角不是權值股而是一組同題材股票
用兩個主角股票的盤中價格、漲跌與成交金額重建當日戲劇性
用一個共同催化解釋族群同步，再補基本面、券商觀點或籌碼線索
同時保留追高、過熱、法人反向操作或催化延續性的風險
以觀眾持股或次日方向問題收尾
observed_gaps: 兩篇完整樣本都主要講兩檔記憶體股票，仍沒有充分展示頻道簡介承諾的大盤廣度
兩篇样本都没有完整呈现三大法人、融資券、借券、期貨與選擇權
兩篇都集中在記憶體題材，不能證明其他盤型也使用相同結構或語氣
兩篇樣本含大量 Line、老師與飆股名單導流，這些只能列入排除規則，不能成為生成風格
尚無 Ben 對生成標題或文稿的保留/淘汰理由

hard_gates: All market facts belong to the same completed Taiwan session or carry an explicit earlier timestamp.
The episode has one clear market-level question, not only a stock gainer list.
At least two source classes support the angle, with at least one official or primary source.
At least one market-structure signal and one event, attention, or flow signal are present.
Every security uses a market-qualified ID and has clickable source evidence.
Missing data remains UNKNOWN and does not become zero.

market_core: TWSE weighted-index close/change and total turnover
TWSE/TPEx advancing, declining and unchanged counts
sector_rotation: Official industry-index or reviewed industry-group performance
Top and bottom sectors with breadth, not one representative stock only
cash_flow: Foreign investor, investment trust and dealer net buys/sells
Per-security institutional flow for anchor securities when available
leverage_and_positioning: Margin financing and short selling change
TAIFEX futures close, basis, open interest and institutional positions
Put/Call Ratio and clearly defined options context
events_and_attention: X and YouTube as OPINION/attention evidence only

must_do: Separate confirmed fact, market interpretation and unknown.
Name the publisher, title and time on every readable source card.
Attribute broker target prices and creator views to their source.
Use conditional tomorrow scenarios with measurable thresholds sourced from the FactPack.
must_not_do: Claim that price/volume alone proves institutional accumulation.
Claim that two stocks share an order or catalyst without evidence.
Turn an X or YouTube opinion into a finance fact.
Invent index contribution, flow, options positions, prices or causal explanations.
Use named creator catchphrases or line-by-line imitation.
Promote Line groups, teachers, free stock lists, exact entries/exits or guaranteed returns.

feedback_needed: Ben keep/reject decision for each daily angle
Whether the script was usable with light edit, heavy edit or discarded
